brief:
Colombia officially opened its embassy in Jerusalem on Wednesday, becoming one of a small number of countries to move its diplomatic mission to the holy city, Middle East Eye reported. The decision represents a departure from Colombia's previous stance on Israel.

The opening follows recent decisions by other nations to establish embassies in Jerusalem, a city whose status remains contested in Israeli-Palestinian negotiations.

title: Colombia opens embassy in Jerusalem, breaking regional isolation stance
